name: Wiccan

abilityDetails.Neutralize: Buff yetenek doğruluğunu belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Resistance Up: Fiziksel Direnci ve Enerji Direncini belirtilen güçte artırır.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Shock: Zamanla elektrik tabanlı şok hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Plasma: Aktifken enerji hasarı verir, blok yeterliliğini %50 azaltır ve Mükemmel Blok şansını kaldırır.
abilityDetails.Power Efficiency: Özel saldırıların güç maliyetini belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Energy Vulnerability: Enerji Direncini azaltarak saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen enerji hasarını artırır.
abilityDetails.Degeneration: Rakibe zamanla doğrudan, engellenemez hasar verir.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Bonusları yakmaya çevirir — yakmaya immün şampiyon kullan. Asla ona şok uygulama, degeneration ile karşılık verir.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Mystic sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Spell Mastery
Resistance Up also allows Wiccan to block Unblockable attacks from Cosmic Champions.
Incinerate effects have a [5 - 50]% chance to not consume Shock Debuffs when creating a Plasma.
If the Opponent is Shock Immune, Shocks turn into Degeneration with the same Potency and Duration, but counts as Shocks for Wiccan's other abilities.
immunityDetails:
• Zırh Kırma Bağışıklığı 🛡️
• Kontrolleri Tersine Çevirme Bağışıklığı 🧠

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Wiccan uses magic on his Basic attacks, causing them to deal Energy Damage instead of Physical.
Physical Resistance decreased by -[1,178.57].
Immunity to Reversed Controls and Armor Break due his mastery of the Arcane Arts.
When struck by True Damage, instantly gain +40% of the Power gained from the Hit.
If inflicted with a Concussion or Disorient Debuff from a Science Champion, one Personal Passive or Debuff caused by Wiccan is removed.

abilitySections.title: Cantrips
content: When Well-Timed Blocked, inflicts a non-stacking Neutralize Debuff of 100% Potency that lasts for 10 second(s).

When the Opponent's ability fails due to reduced Ability Accuracy or Wiccan's personal Immunities, inflict an Incinerate Debuff, reducing Block Proficiency by 50% and dealing [6,863.4] Energy Damage over 10 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Spells
content: Cast a Spell by performing a specific action. As a Defender Wiccan casts a Spell every 10 second(s) following the order below, but this timer resets and moves to the next Spell in order when Wiccan is knocked down, and pauses on his Specials.
Shield (Dash back and hold block for 1.2 second(s)): Gain a [687.5] Resistance Up Passive for 10 second(s). Max 3 Stacks.
Flame (Medium, Light, Light, Light, Medium): Inflicts an Incinerate Passive, reducing Block Proficiency by 50% and dealing [6,863.4] Energy Damage over 10 second(s).
Silence (Medium, Light, Light, Light, Light): Inflicts a non-stacking Neutralize Passive of 100% Potency that lasts for 5 second(s).

Arcane Theft (Heavy): Gain a Power Gain Passive, granting 1% of Max power over 10 second(s). Nullifies up to one Fury, Precision, or Power Gain Buff off the Opponent to increase the potency of the Power Gain Passive to 5%.
Pause all active Spells and Debuffs for 6 second(s) when casting a Spell that does not exist or activating a Special Attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation gain a Regeneration Buff, recovering 7% of missing Health over 6 second(s). Recovers 100% of missing health caused by Energy Damage from Bursts and damaging Debuffs.
Last 2 hits cast the last casted Spell with duration increased by 8 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: All hits inflict a Shock Debuff, dealing [9,151.2] Energy Damage over 15 second(s). Inflicting an Incinerate into a Shock, or vice versa, will fuse those two effects into a Plasma that has the property of both, lasting 6 second(s). Plasmas do not pause.

Last hit grants a non-stacking Power Efficiency Buff of 30% Potency, lasting for 3 second(s) plus 3 second(s) per unique Spell active at the beginning of the Special, and pauses during Specials. As a Defender this Buff always lasts 20 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Inflict an Energy Vulnerability Debuff, reducing Energy Resistance by [5,107.14] for 20 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Spell Mastery
content: Resistance Up also allows Wiccan to block Unblockable attacks from Cosmic Champions.
Incinerate effects have a [5 - 50]% chance to not consume Shock Debuffs when creating a Plasma.
If the Opponent is Shock Immune, Shocks turn into Degeneration with the same Potency and Duration, but counts as Shocks for Wiccan's other abilities.
